batting.name: JC Buttler
batting.dismissal: st Q de Kock b RD Chahar

batting.name: RG Sharma
batting.dismissal: c C Sakariya b CH Morris

batting.name: SA Yadav
batting.dismissal: c JC Buttler b CH Morris

balls.text: drilled past the non-striker. Low full toss at leg stump, backs into the leg side to create room and cracks this along the floor
inside edge onto stumps as he looks to drill this wide yorker through the covers. They sneak a run
that's landed just outside the pitch and that is a no-ball. An attempted slower ball at length, wide outside off. The law is that you can't land it outside the strip
just evades Rohit running back from extra cover. It's a slower ball at length, wide outside off. Reaches out and looks to carve it over cover
length ball outside off at 134kph. That was there for the taking as well, but he's looked to slog and got an inside edge that's trickled to the keeper
jumps across for the ramp but this is a slower ball dipping outside off and he's had to adjust to try and whip it. Can't connect. Lovely change-up from NCN
inside edge past the keeper! Length ball there for the hitting outside off. Doesn't manage to connect on it but gets lucky
yorker at middle stump, jammed into the turf at deep midwicket
Bumrah takes an easy one. Low full toss and very tight at his legs, looks to whip over midwicket, comes off the high part of the bat and floats harmlessly over the pitch
full slower ball outside off, driven along the ground to sweeper
yorker at leg stump, backs into the leg side and drives to long-on
yorker at middle stump, can't do more than jam that back to the bowler
full toss at middle stump, mistimed flick out to deep midwicket
clubbed over long-on. Misses the yorker by about a foot and that's enough for Dube to swing through this one
yorker at middle stump, jammed out to long-on
knocks out middle stump! Mumbai really nailing these yorkers right now. Samson clears the front leg and looks to whip that, but looks like it's got a tiny deflection into the stumps
full at leg stump, mistimed slog to deep square's right
yorker at leg stump, cops that on the pad as he looks to slog
full and at off stump, mistimes the attempted slog. It rolls out to deep midwicket
low full toss just outside off, looks to drill down the ground, sliced on the bounce to backward point
low full toss outside off, driven sweetly but can't beat sweeper
nails another yorker at the toes, can't do more than deflect this into the leg side off the pads
offcutter, short of a length outside off. Looks to slice that into the gap but finds short third
yorker at the legs again, sweet connection on the attempted slog, but along the floor to deep midwicket
yorker length and slams into the pads as he looks to swing it into the leg side
overpitched at leg stump, flicked to deep square's left
nails the leg stump yorker, jammed down to long-on
low full toss, swerves away a little from leg stump. Reaches out and flicks to deep midwicket
offcutter at a length outside off, waits on that and slices it fine of short third
nonchalantly lofted over the bowler. Low full toss just outside off, big backlift helps him generate power to get this into the boundary
yorker just outside off, clears the front leg and chops it to sweeper's left
yorker length at leg stump, whipped on the bounce to deep midwicket
full and very wide outside off, Samson doesn't step out, left alone
full at leg stump, clubbed along the ground to long-on
low full toss outside off, backs away and gets the attempted drive off the inside edge to long-on
short of a length and wide outside off, chopped to deep extra cover
tossed up wide and turning away, he leaves it alone
muscled over the wide long-on boundary. Short of a length and sitting up outside off, a bit of turn, but he goes against it and that is flat and over the boundary
full and into leg stump, driven to long-on
googly at a length outside off, looks to whip off the back foot and is beaten
full and just outside off, looks for the slog and gets a thick inside edge to deep midwicket
slider at a length on off stump, punched to long-off on the back foot
googly, short and wide outside off. Left alone
length at leg stump, whipped to deep midwicket
full at leg stump, hoicked towards long-on
short at middle stump, hurries him on the pull, dragged on the bounce to deep midwicket
short of a length and tight at leg stump, shovels that to fine leg's right off the inside edge
short of a length just outside off, chopped to sweeper cover
clattered! Length ball, a slower one, pushed across him. But he's got the timing spot on - huge backlift, not feet whatsoever, but pummeled wide of mid-off
slower short ball at middle stump, hooked towards fine leg

Boult indicates he's taken this on the bounce at long-on. That was struck with some power. Short of a length and outside off, pulled flat, swerving and dipping to Boult's left. He can't get this body behind this but manages to gather on the bounce
short and just outside off, punched firmly to long-off off the back foot
full at off stump, gets forward and drives with the turn to long-off
length and turning away from middle and leg stump, defended down the pitch
full at middle stump, flicked to deep midwicket
slogged between long-on and deep midwicket. Dube finds a release. It's a length ball at middle stump, he's not quite got this off the middle, but he's found the gap
short of a length and turning away outside off, chopped to sweeper cover
short of a length and tight at leg stump and he's late on the glance again, gets it pitch side on the leg side
offcutter at a length outside off, stabbed to extra cover's right and Krunal puts in a dive to make that a fourth dot ball
short of a length and tight at the body, pats it back to the bowler
short of a length just outside off, under-edge on the attempted cut
short of a length and just outside off, chopped straight to backward point
length and into the corridor, gets forward and flicks to long-on
googly at a length on off stump, defended on the front foot
leading edge taken. Full loopy googly at leg stump, Jaiswal gets low and forward, closes the face too early on the flick and it is a simple catch for a visibly frustrated Chahar
short of a length and turning into leg stump, whipped straight to midwicket and is disappointed with himself
slog sweep really high in the air, but clears midwicket. Wrong'un, full and just outside off. Gets down quickly for the sweep and gets this off the low part of the bat
length and just outside off, driven with the turn to long-off
short and just outside off, backs away and punches to sweeper cover
pulled between deep square and deep midwicket. Pushed through flat and short at middle stump and this is caressed
low full toss flicked to deep midwicket from the stumps
length at off stump, punched towards deep midwicket
length at middle stump, gets forward and flicks to deep midwicket
length at the stumps, pats it into the leg side
dragged to the midwicket boundary. Length at middle stump, steps out right away and launches this. Looked like it had distance on it but that was deceptive. One bounce and into the boundary
short of a length on leg stump, clipped to deep backward square
crashed in front of sweeper cover. Short and wide outside off, waits on that and places it perfectly off the back foot

beats him in flight! Lovely follow-up from Chahar. Buttler steps out early and is met with a beautiful dipping, drifting delivery. It must have appeared to be in his arc briefly, but by the time he gets a shot away, it has already landed and spins past him. He was looking to go over long-on
hammered over deep square. This is dropped very short and sits up nicely for him to swivel and dispatch with a pull
length at middle stump, swept aerially to deep square's right
length at leg stump, steps out and pats it to deep midwicket
full and into leg stump this time as Buttler shuffles into the off, flicked to deep midwicet
full and wide and floating away, in anticipation of Buttler stepping out. Too wide and Buttler has stayed put
backs away too far and is forced to leave. Yadav fires it full and wide outside off
short of a length and tight at middle stump, punched to long-on off the back foot
full at leg stump, flicked to deep square

slapped between deep midwicket and long-on. Yadav's defensive length isn't doing its job right now. Short of a length and outside off. Buttler has rapid hands, and he's waiting for the pull. Gets it decisively between those two fielders
length at leg stump, deep in the crease to tuck this to deep midwicket
short of a length and just outside off, shuffles into line and opens the face to run that to third man

oh this is a huge hit! Jaiswal is batting with some clarity here. He's set up for the short ball before it even comes, a step back into the crease. NCN's short one is at a friendly height and he pulls it long over deep square
backs into the leg side and opens up the covers for himself. Length ball following him down leg but he arches back and slashes on the rise between mid-off and extra
short at middle stump, pulled to deep square off the inside half
short at middle stump, walks down the pitch and steers this through square leg
length and into the pads, tickled with the angle to fine leg
short of a length, 101kph, at off stump. Steps out and clips this to deep midwicket
pumped over midwicket! Looked at ease with that one. Short and turning in a touch at off stump, he's quickly moved his weight onto the back foot and puled cleanly
swiped over midwicket. Stepped out again, but this time he's prepared for the shorter length and the angle across him. Stays upright and fetches this from outside off
short of a length at middle stump, punched towards long-on and can't beat the bowler's dive
short of a length and sliding across the corridor, beaten on the cut
Chahar dives backwards at point and can't hold on. Buttler steps out and looks to force this into the leg side as it skids away from him. Pre-meditated. Leading edge loops over the fielder
yorker just outside off, looks to chop that behind point, mistimed

would have been gone with the direct hit. Buttler takes on Pollard at mid-on to break the dot-ball streak. Wasn't even close and wasn't even trying to get in. Length at middle stump, pushed straight to mid-on at a decent pace
inside edge pops up but safely away from the bowler. Length outside off, angled-bat slash at this and that floats pitch side on the off side
short of a length and tight at off stump with the angle in. Wants to stab that through the covers and miscues it
good length and in at middle stump, blocked on the front foot
length and in at off stump, defended into the covers
short of a length and hurried on the pull again, gets it to deep square's right
length and tight at off stump, defended into the off side
hauled to the midwicket boundary. Not in control, but he hasn't held back. Short and getting steep and tight at shoulder height, but he hooks it into the gap and that bounces into the boundary
short of a length at middle stump, swiped to deep square off the front foot
length and slanted in at off stump. Looks to force that through the covers on the up, gets a thick inside edge to fine leg
short of a length at middle stump, walks down the pitch and pushes this into the leg side
yorker at leg stump but Buttler is watchful. Jams this out
length and going across the corridor from middle stump. Closes the face and gets a leading edge out to third man
length at off stump, pushed towards mid-off off the front foot
squeezes it between slip and short third. One dive to the right, one to the left, beats both. Length and in at off stump, looks to dead-bat that and opens the face late
full toss at knee height, patted towards mid-on hurriedly
length and in at off stump, tentative push into the covers with the feet rooted
nearly sneaks through. Full and swung in, Buttler looking to drive with a straight bat and gets an inside edge onto pad
short of a length, swung in and tight at the body. Pushed into the leg side with the front leg clear
past the outside edge. Short of a length and he's fishing for the one that curves in but this goes on with the angle
length and straight through, wide outside off. Beaten on the slash
raps him on the pad after curving it in from a middle and leg stump line. He was looking to glance that, it was high and possibly missing leg
good length and curving into leg stump, stays deep in the crease and tickles that fine
flicks to fine leg to seal the win. Cutter at a length on leg stump, stands tall and whips this away
low full toss at off stump, mistimed drive, off the inside half to deep midwicket

full slower ball outside off, lines it up and looks to crunch it over extra cover. Ended up slicing it a little, but that gap was big enough. Tewatia tried to pull it back in after chasing from long-off, couldn't manage it
short of a length outside off, chopped to point's left
short and just outside off, steered to third man
slower bouncer wide outside off, mistimed cut ends up at point off the under-edge

struck straight on the helmet and that runs past short fine leg into the boundary. Pollard was on his feet, gesturing at the ball to go, go into the boundary. Morris checked with him and then looks on confounded as the ball trickles away. It was outside off, he looked to duck that and copped it on the side of the left side of the helmet. He's on his feet still and laughing around. A bunch of fist bumps and ready for the next ball
low yorker dipping at off stump, miscued flick off the inside half of the bat. It keeps deep square interested to his left but he doesn't get to it
unreal! Wow. Short ball just outside off, shuffles deep into the crease, a step back, and punches this over extra cover off the back foot! What a shot
full slower ball at middle stump, driven to long-on
beaten on the outside edge and then has to scramble back as Samson throws at the stumps. Short ball slammed into the pitch and going across him as he pokes at it

inside edge onto middle stump! He's looked fidgety whenever the ball curves in at the stumps, and once again he's caught in an awkward position. Too close to try and crash it through the covers. But this has been an important innings for him, and for Mumbai, kept the pressure on Rajasthan after SKY's wicket
slower ball at a length, turning into the body and catching him on the box as he shapes to pull this
full and into off stump, inside edge onto boot as he looks to drive
just over deep midwicket. That looked massive at first, but the height did that. Still a good hit though. A cutter at a length outside off, shuffles into line and slogs confidently
low full toss at off stump, jammed out towards mid-off
offcutter at a length outside off, punched on the up to extra cover's right
short and just outside off, pulled to long-on's left
full at middle stump, flicked to deep square
full and just outside off, aerial drive towards sweeper cover
oh does well to take four off this. It's a yorker, slightly down leg side, but he picks it early and meets it on the full. Flicks to deep square's left
length and just outside off, punched to long-off's right
short and just outside off, cut tot sweeper's right
full outside off, leans in and flicks to long-on
full and down leg side, beaten on the sweep
short of a length just outside off, creates enough room to cut to sweeper's right and come back for a second
full at leg stump, flicked to short fine
pumped straight over the bowler! Googly at off stump, full and he clears the front leg and gives this a proper tonk. Sliced it a little because it turned away but that went long
slower ball at a length, wide outside off, mistimed drive to extra cover's right

wow that is superb work at long-on from Miller. Length ball carted to his left off the front foot, he runs to his left, slides to pick up an uses the momentum from it to spring back up and get the throw in to keep that to one

Jaiswal nearly takes a stunner. Full slower ball outside off, wants to hit that over long-off and skews it over extra cover. Jaiswal runs backwards and puts in a lunge to get two hands on it, but can't manage to hold on
full slower ball outside off, reaches out and chips that to sweeper's left
yorker at off stump, jammed down to long-off
full and just outside off, leans in and drives to sweeper cover
short of a length outside off, under-edge on the cut to sweeper
length at middle stump, swept to deep backward square
short of a length outside off, chopped to backward point
length ball sliding at leg stump, steps out and cops that on the pad as he misses on the flick
full at middle stump, driven with the turn to long-on
full dipping slower ball outside off, waits for that to arrive and places the drive to mid-off's right
low full toss outside off, driven firmly to long-on
slower ball, short and outside off. Punched on the up to sweeper's left and this time it's Parag who puts in a dive, takes a tumble, and recovers to throw it back in
length outside off, punched on the up to extra cover
length and just outside off, leans in and pats it through square leg to bring up his fifty. This will feel nice for QDK, had been searching for runs so far this season
slides past the outside edge. Length ball shoots up in the corridor as he looks to drive on the up

brilliant effort from Tewatia at sweeper. Short ball cut firmly to his right and he's sprinted, stretched out and flapped this into the ground. He is very close to the paddings though, so they'll take a replay. And they find it's alright
length ball just outside off, looks to force through the covers, gets it down the pitch off the inside edge
overpitched at leg stump, leans in and flicks to deep square's left
bouncer dropped too short outside off, left alone
short outside off, punched to sweeper cover
misses that but it's deflected wide of the keeper off his shoe. Dipping slower ball outside off, was looking to ramp that. It's deflected off the front shoe between keeper and short third
short of a length outside off, pushed to backward point on the up
short of a length at off stump, allows that on and steers to third man's left
bouncer at a middle stump, sways out of line to leave it
full slower ball at leg stump, leans in and flicks to fine leg
short of a length at leg stump, pushed to deep midwicket off the back foot
flicked straight to midwicket! A dipping slower ball at middle stump, wants to loft that over the man but he can't find the elevation. Morris produces a wicket once again
short of a length outside off, mistimed punch to extra cover
low full toss at leg stump, stands tall and punched firmly past his partner to beat long-on to the right
short and just outside off, punched on the up to sweeper cover
slower ball at a length outside off, shuffles and flicks to long-on
short of a length at off stump, pushed back down the pitch
short and into the body. Shapes to pull but adjusts late as that stops on him. Manages to get it to fine leg's right
offcutter at a length on leg stump, leans in and pushes through vacant midwicket
low full toss at middle stump, punched to long-on off the front foot
full slower ball at leg stump, driven to long-on
full at middle stump, driven past the bowler with the full face offered

appeal for lbw as he looks to chop this cutter. It was coming in from outside off, struck him in front of off stump. Bat and pad were very close. Does he have an inside edge on it? Samson reviews at the very last second. After it looked like the discussion was done and everyone had made their peace with it. There is bat on that, QDK is safe
full slower ball outside off, gets down on a knee and deflects to third man
short of a length across the corridor, has a slash and gets a thick outside edge that sprints to third man's left. he dives and gets a hand on it but there was too much to do and too little time
reverse sweep. Tewatia's been put under pressure right away. Length ball pushed across off stump, uses the angle and taps that between point and short third
length at middle stump, swished on the up to deep midwicket's left
only marginally short outside off but he's made it count. It was tight at the stumps too, but he puts those wrists to use for the square cut
everyday business for SKY. Stretches out at this length ball on off, gets under it and opens the face to lift it over extra cover with the turn
full at off stump, driven back to the bowler
length and sliding on at off stump, gets deep in the crease and whips to deep midwicket

chipped straight to mid-on! That is soft. It's an overpitched ball at leg stump, he's caught halfway between trying to lift this on-drive and hitting it wide of the fielder. Ends up giving him a comfortably grab at waist height
short of a length just outside off, eased to sweeprer's right off the back foot
length at off stump, defended into the covers
full and hits the pads as he looks to flick, appeal for lbw turned down and they won't review. Ptiched outside leg
short at leg stump, looks to pull and is cramped. Deflected fine off the thigh guard
welcome, Tipo! QDK greets his friend with a pristine pull over midwicket. Short of a length outside off, so quickly in position and so effortless in the swing
low full toss at middle stump, flicked to deep midwicket
full and into middle stump, driven sweetly with the angle but can't beat mid-on
length at middle stump, backs away and punches to long-off
short of a length just outside off, mistimed punch trickles back to the bowler off the inside edge
brings out the trademark pull. Short of a length at off stump, forward press, swivel, sent over midwicket
short of a length outside off, a subdued pull to deep midwicket's right
full and wide outside off as QDK threatens to ramp him again. Forced to jab into the covers
offcutter at a length just outside off, looks to drive on the up and gets a thick outside edge to short third
full and just outside leg stump, steps out and looks to flick. Rapped on the pads
slower ball at a length on middle stump, leans in and flicks to deep midwicket
swipes that over short fine! Length ball just outside off, drops his weight into the off side, gets under this and gives it a proper whip. Flat and over the boundary

just past backward point. Length and shapes away in the corridor, opens the face and runs this between short third and point. Miller dives to the right and gets a hand on it, but it is parried into the boundary
short of a length at leg stump, looks to pull and cops that on the thigh. That didn't rise
length and tight at middle stump, gets his attempted punch on the rise to mid-on's left
full offcutter at leg stump, leans in and flicks straight to midwicket
nicely placed. Length and skidding on wide outside off. Didn't move the feet too much but leaned in and patted it past extra cover
this looks a decent shout for lbw as Rohit gets down and tries to sweep a slower ball. It was pretty full, but looks like it pitched outside leg
length and at the stumps, backs away and chops to sweeper cover
slower ball at a length on off stump, gets forward and clips to deep square

survives the run-out chance! Short of a length outside off, cut straight to cover point off the front foot. Tewatia fumbles a touch but recovers quickly to get back up for the throw. Wouldn't even have been close with a direct hit
length at middle stump, pushed towards mid-on off the front foot
beats the outside edge. Landed at a length in the corridor, lands on the seam and jags past the bat. Wobbles in front of Sanju and he can't gather cleanly
short of a length across off stump, uses the angle for the steer but can't beat short third
length and into off stump, uses the angle to turn that to deep square
length at leg stump, dropped pitch side into the leg side with soft hands
full and just outside off, driven on the bounce, sweetly, but straight to extra cover
full and just outside off, leans in for the drive to extra cover
length and just outside off, punched on the rise to sweeper cover
good length and a bit of wobble, gets forward and defends at off stump
short of a length and at middle stump, gets on his toes and clips to deep square
